name: Stream Bridge
author: Fraser Simpson
description: Resolve tracks through multiple Eclipse Music add-ons with ordered fallback and per-add-on connection tests.

actions.name: audio.source
actions.why: Finds the requested recording through configured Eclipse Music add-ons and returns a playable audio stream.

actions.name: network
actions.why: Connects to the Eclipse add-ons you choose, which may be hosted on different public HTTPS domains.

actions.name: settings.page
actions.why: Lets you configure, enable, test and order multiple Eclipse add-ons and playback fallback behaviour.

actions.name: notify
actions.why: Reports the result of each add-on connection and search test.

settings.label: Add-on 1 URL
settings.description: Eclipse add-on manifest URL, including any token path. Example: https://host.example/token/manifest.json

settings.label: Enable add-on 1
settings.description: Include this add-on in the playback fallback order.

settings.label: Test add-on 1
settings.description: Checks the manifest and performs a sample search. No audio is played.

settings.label: Try the next add-on on failure
settings.description: When enabled, continue down the configured add-on list if a provider is offline, has no match, or cannot return a playable stream.

settings.label: Strict track matching
settings.description: Require exact normalised title and artist matches. Disable only if your add-ons use inconsistent metadata.

settings.label: Duration tolerance
settings.description: Maximum duration difference accepted when both sides provide a duration.
